CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 04 / 11

Demand elasticity

Elasticity versus slope彈性與斜率

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Distinguish elasticity from slope. On a linear demand curve, elasticity changes along the curve; a constant slope does not imply constant elasticity.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

斜率用單位變化，彈性用百分比。線性需求 Q=a−bP 的 Ed=bP/Q；高價低量端彈性大，斜率仍相同。

Slope uses absolute changes in P and Q; elasticity uses percentage changes. On linear demand Q=a−bP, Ed=bP/Q. It is higher near the high-price, low-quantity end even though slope is constant.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：For Q=100−P, Ed at P=80,Q=20 is 4; at P=20,Q=80 it is 0.25. 同線不同點的彈性不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

For Q=100−P at P=50,Q=50, Ed is? 彈性多少？
